impact: A full-history push exhausted a 10 GiB fixture volume after a successful import. The local push tree cache was over eleven times the encrypted ciphertext written so far. These are partial push sizes, not final store sizes.
workaround: Move only verified age ciphertext and public store.json to a disposable VM disk, keep synthetic private keys on RAM, bind mount the same store path, enable zstd filesystem compression on local public pushed-tree cache, then resume the existing push.
coreFix: Assigned separately by lead; no change to the core push cache in this CDN branch.
